title: Misleading Gemini Code Assist for individuals Privacy Notice in VScode extension

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides clear details, screenshots, and reproduction steps explaining the contradictory and misleading phrasing between the privacy notice text and the settings toggle.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Updating the privacy notice wording and setting prompt in CloudFreePrivacyNotice.tsx is a minor UI text adjustment accompanied by updating unit test assertions in CloudFreePrivacyNotice.test.tsx.

summary.problem: Misleading and contradictory privacy notice wording where the introductory text states users can opt out below, but the setting option is an opt-in selection.
summary.root_cause: Inconsistent framing between the introductory explanatory text and the opt-in/opt-out toggle options.
summary.context: The issue highlights user confusion regarding whether selecting the privacy setting enables or disables data collection for machine learning models.

steps: Align the introductory privacy notice text with the selection toggle in CloudFreePrivacyNotice.tsx so the opt-in/opt-out behavior is clear and consistent.
Ensure the option labels and prompt question explicitly clarify whether the user is granting or denying permission for product improvement data collection.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The privacy notice UI renders consistent text and choices for data collection opt-in/opt-out preferences.
verification_steps: Update tests in CloudFreePrivacyNotice.test.tsx to assert the revised, clear privacy notice text and selection options.
Execute vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/privacy/CloudFreePrivacyNotice.test.tsx to verify all tests pass.
